column1: # Game profile of Fire Emblem: Three Houses (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.2.0 = v327680). In bring-up

# Koei Tecmo's older KTGL engine on NVN (co-developed with Intelligent Systems), SDK 6.5.0 (the oldest so far); modules main + subsdk0 (GLSLC, NVN's runtime shader compiler) + subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk.

# RomFS: the LINKDATA archive DATA0.bin (index of 32-byte entries) + DATA1.bin (6.9 GB), loose overrides in patch1–4/ (listed by patchN/INFO0.bin), WebM movies in nx/movie, KTSL sound banks (*.ktsl2stbin).

# Compressed entries and *.gz files are Koei Tecmo's chunked zlib. The shaders are GLSLC outputs in SPKG packages (G2S containers, as in Age of Calamity), loose and inside DATA1.bin (shader_split.py kt_shaders)

# PEANUTS: handheld: the game renders at 1280x720 instead of 1920x1080; on the AYN Thor (Adreno 740) its 1080p frame took about 17.4 ms of GPU time (47-54 fps), handheld holds close to 60 (2026-11-14)
# camera on the right stick in the monastery and in battle
# KTGL updates the game 60 times a second on the main thread and presents the latest update from its render thread with the render mode's interval (2 on the Switch: 30 fps).
# Rewriter cuts on 1.2.0 main (patches.py) set every mode's interval to 1, as in the engine's own 60 fps modes, so game mode gives 60 fps at the same game speed;
# one more drops the render thread's forced 30 fps in the opening movie and scenes such as character creation; two more make the frame limiter sleep instead of yield
# and the render thread wait a frame instead of 16 µs
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize. Link's Awakening's partition until measured
# KTGL compiles 9 built-in GLSL shaders at boot with the game's own GLSLC (subsdk0; sources in main): the NSP script captures them once on the Mac with DM_GLSLC_CAPTURE=<version dir>/glslc_capture
# (hle_glslc.c), as for any game whose main holds GLSL sources and imports glslcCompile
# Reviewed FPSLocker code plan: exact main build and expected bytes; no pack-file mutation.
# PEANUTS begin: picture shapes without code of the game's own (aspect_plan, dm/host/aspect_plan.h): Game settings > Display > Fill
# The three words of the community's 21:9 patch for this build (Fl4sh9174, Switch-Emulator-Ultrawide-FPS-Mods), read on the 1.2.0 pack's main: the 16/9 float
# at main+0xcb801c becomes the picture's shape, and the two calls at main+0x55a6c4 and main+0x5653f8 become NOPs. What the two calls do is not known here (the patch
# has no comment); the note says what was seen on a device.
